rapport_notes: Nicole is warm, patient, and responsive to customer clarifications; maintains a professional, friendly tone throughout the call.
process_discipline_notes: After the agenda question ('What are your biggest concerns...'), customer said 'I don't really have any concerns,' but Nicole did not hold silence—she immediately pivoted to service features without acknowledging the open response.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: We received your request for an estimate and I just need about ten to fifteen minutes. Is now a good time?
evidence_quotes.agenda: What are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: 'I don't really have any concerns... should be fairly, hopefully, standard simple move.' Nicole: 'Okay.' [No follow-up or probe into what 'standard' means, no 'tell me more,' no second layer.]
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: We provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: A few days before the move, you will be receiving an email introducing the movers to you. You will have an option to see their photos and basic info.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: If we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.
evidence_quotes.communication_not_covered: No mention of day-before call, named crew lead, or inbox updates.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: For a typical one bedroom apartment, it usually takes around two and a half to three and a half hours with two movers and one truck... Since you're moving from a first floor apartment to a third floor apartment with 25 minutes drive time between location, I will estimate this move to take around three to four hours.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: We will be charging you for the total time consumed by the end of the move.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Once we go over the minimum the time is per rated in fifteen minute increments.
evidence_quotes.no_close_ask: Call ends with scheduling the virtual walkthrough; no rate-lock statement or explicit ask to book the move.

top_strength: Nicole executed a clean, properly-framed quid pro quo upfront, asked the agenda question immediately before probing, and delivered all four primary differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, and time-based pricing logic) clearly and in the right sequence.
coaching_note: When a customer says 'I don't have concerns,' pause and probe deeper—ask 'what does a standard move look like to you?' or 'anything you want to confirm before we move forward?'—rather than pivoting straight to your feature pitch; also, Communication (day-before call, named crew lead, inbox updates) was never mentioned and should have been in the Stage 2 delivery.
